name: Casa Vale da Lama
description: Casa Vale da Lama is a regenerative farm-stay eco resort at Quinta Vale da Lama in Odiáxere, Lagos, SW Algarve — quality hospitality on a working organic farm, balancing comfort and sustainability with a touch of farm-house flair.
mission: Welcoming guests into a working regenerative landscape, so that hospitality funds and demonstrates the restoration it depends on.
